censor_reason: 217/7957 and 222/7957 censored train occurrences have saturated zero-gradient censor terms. Those occurrences contribute 18.2471% and 18.5491% of the censor loss component. This loss concentration makes the implementation limitation material to that component; it does not establish how much total training failure it caused.
